```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::ParquetFileReader$create("data/history.parquet")$GetSchema()
```

```{r}
#| label: history-schema
#| cache: true

markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    probability_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date),
    horizon = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ ">90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 30 ~ "30–90 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 7 ~ "7–30 days",
      days_to_resolution >= 1 ~ "1–7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    horizon = factor(
      horizon,
      levels = c(">90 days", "30–90 days", "7–30 days", "1–7 days", "Final day"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false

groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

# Inspect column types
glimpse(groups)
glimpse(market_groups)

# Inspect example values
head(groups, 5)
head(market_groups, 5)

# Check row counts
nrow(groups)
nrow(market_groups)

# Compare column names with markets
intersect(names(markets), names(market_groups))
intersect(names(groups), names(market_groups))
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket = horizon) |>
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(probability_error),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

accuracy

ggplot(accuracy, aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
final_day <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0)

calibration <- final_day |>
  mutate(
    probability_bin = cut(
      probability,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_bin) |>
  summarise(
    actual_rate = mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n_distinct(market_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

calibration

ggplot(final_day, aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram()
```
